what: B5 does not actually guard the deferred empty-title slug path
scenario_or_breakage: The plan acknowledges empty title yields testuser/-123 but defers it, while create-branch.sh only checks the user-prefix shape and would not reject that suffix before git checkout; B5 also says to assert BRANCH_NAME contains the slug even though BRANCH_NAME is sourced from the canned git-current-branch stub, not from the derived create-branch argument
suggested_fix: Add an explicit empty-title case that either fails with STEP_FAILED before branch creation or falls back to a safe slug, and assert the create-branch --branch argument in invoke-log or make git-current-branch reflect the branch just created

what: The copy-plan failure path is neither concretely implemented nor covered by a B-case
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says cp failure should become STEP_FAILED=copy-plan plus exit 2, but the implementation steps only show a bare cp and this script explicitly runs with errexit off, so a missing plan-from-issue.txt can silently continue unless rc is captured; B5-B10 do not exercise this and the test section does not scope the omission out
suggested_fix: Add explicit cp rc capture with STEP_FAILED=copy-plan and exit 2, then add a B-case with an existing --preflight-tmpdir that lacks plan-from-issue.txt and assert rc 2 plus STEP_FAILED=copy-plan

what: The dirty-tree unknown branch is named but untested
scenario_or_breakage: The plan treats STATUS=dirty and STATUS=unknown identically, but B7 only configures STATUS=dirty, so a parsing/default bug for unknown can ship without a regression failure
suggested_fix: Parameterize B7 over dirty and unknown or add B7-unknown with the same bail and no-subsequent-helper assertions

what: gh issue view failure is acknowledged but absent from B5-B10
scenario_or_breakage: The Edge Cases section requires STEP_FAILED=gh-issue-view plus exit 2, but the concrete function steps only say to use gh issue view and the B-case list has no auth/network failure case; a failed gh call can feed the empty-title path or leave partial feature-description.txt unguarded
suggested_fix: Add rc/stderr capture for gh issue view and a B-case that makes the gh stub exit non-zero, asserting rc 2, STEP_FAILED=gh-issue-view, and no copy-plan or branch creation after the failure

what: The order-of-operations failure mode is not translated into concrete test assertions
scenario_or_breakage: The failure mode says invoke-log order assertions are the warning signal, but B5-B10 only specify success/skip/no-subsequent checks and never require the full snapshot -> gh -> cp -> workflow-path -> persist -> dirty -> branch -> current-branch -> plan-log -> summary order
suggested_fix: Add an explicit ordered invoke-log assertion to B5 green-path so reordering the absorbed Step 0 calls fails the harness
